Reference / time/zone

time/zone#

Deterministic time-zone values backed only by bundled IANA tzdata 2026c.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let york = Zone("America/New_York");
let meeting = york.instant(IsoText("2026-12-01T09:00:00").local_date_time());
meeting.string();                                   // "2026-12-01T14:00:00Z"
let there = ZonedDateTime(instant: meeting, zone: Zone("Europe/Berlin"));
there.local_datetime().string() + " " + there.abbreviation();
                                                    // "2026-12-01T15:00:00 CET"
TimeZoneDatabaseVersion().string(); // "2026c"

Description#

Deterministic time-zone values backed only by bundled IANA tzdata 2026c.

Named zones never inspect the host's configured zone or host tzdata. Absolute to local conversion is total for instants whose local date lies in 1..9999. Local gaps throw MissingLocalTime; an ambiguous wall time takes the earlier instant unless fold: Fold.later asks for the other one. FixedZone has no daylight-saving state and uses its name as its abbreviation.
